resultSummary: Croatia 1-2 Spain. Spain through on 12 points.
headline: Croatia 1-2 Spain: Merino's brace sends Spain through
whyCareReason: Spain are into the quarter-finals with two group games still to play. Portugal matched them on 12 points in Group A4.
teaser: Perisic 18, then a red card on 79. Merino 61 and 88. Spain 12 points, England 9.
story: Spain came from behind to beat Croatia 1-2 away on Tuesday 6 October. Ivan Perisic scored on 18 minutes and was sent off on 79. Mikel Merino scored on 61 and 88. Xinhua's table after Tuesday: Spain 4 wins, 12 goals for, 5 against, 12 points. Croatia have 3 points and a goal difference of -10. Spain and Portugal are the two League A sides already through.
stakes: A quarter-final place with a game to spare. England, on 9, cannot be caught by Croatia on points alone from here in a way that passes Spain.
rivalryAngle: Spain's perfect group record is four wins. England's goal difference is better, and it is not enough.
